name: Orb · Ion
description: A plasma globe: pink-to-violet lightning filaments crawling from a hot nucleus to the glass, built as the joint zero set of two animated fields over the direction sphere — so every streamer is genuinely radial, stays rooted while its far end wanders, and flares where it lands on the shell. More streamers grow in as the agent gets louder (WebGL). Ported from Orbkit shdr-13 (MIT).
